# Draft:New Mangalwar Peth

New Mangalwar Peth is an old neighbourhood in the Pune Station area of Mali village of Pune Central of city of Pune. It is full of lush green neighbourhood full of trees & was created just next to the Mangalwar Peth during the expansion of Pune during British times, as earlier it was a part of cantonment. New Mangalwar Peth is an planned neighbourhood following certain town planning schemes such as Pune T.P.S, Mali & Munjeri T.P. Scheme, Kasbe Pune Station T.P.S and Sangamwadi T.P.S. New Mangalwar Peth is also known as Maldhakka or Pune Station Maldhakka. Localities here has good connectivity by major roads, railway and metro. There is Juna Bazar along the banks of Mutha river is famous for purchasing second hand things, Located on Veer Santaji Ghorpade Road. New Mangalwar Peth belongs many important places such as Sinchan Bhavan, Chhatrapati Shivaji Stadium, Dr.Babasaheb Ambedkar Sanskrutik Bhavan, State excise office at 37.Wellesly Road, Dadasaheb Gaikwad PMC Clinic, Shamrao Kalmadi School (Kannada medium school), Rabindranath Tagore Vidyanikatan, Sassoon Hospital, Pune Railway Station, Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan office at Barane Road, There is an Cafe Canada located on Wellesly Road, which reminds of british times. This neighbourhood also has British period antique bunglows & Wada style buildings as similar as in camp & Shivaji Nagar or Deccan.
Sub Neighbourhood
Manik Nagar is an lush green sub Neighbourhood located in New Mangalwar Peth called as Manik Nagar, Pune Station. Manik Nagar is Named after the Manik Odha as the entire Manik Nagar is on the North eastern banks of Manik Odha. Manik Odha was earlier a river but since from ancient urbanization times around British got converted into Odha. There are specific lanes in Manik Nagar which starts along Pune Station Road (Jawaharlal Nehru Road) Such as Lane No. 1, Lane No. 1A, Lane No. 1B, Lane No. 1C, Lane No. 2, Lane No. 2A, Lane No. 2B, Lane No.2C, also the extended lanes within Barane Road and Gadital. Manik Nagar Plots Starts From Final Plot No-1 to Final Plot No-57 of New Mangalwar Peth Along with certain CTS Numbers Such as 409, 412, 423, 428, 430, 442, 447 etc....
New Mangalwar Peth, Pune Station, Pune, 411001
Borders at East – Parts of Mali, West – Manik Odha & Mangalwar Peth North – Parts of Mali, South-Manik Odha & Somwar Peth and New Somwar Peth.
Body – Pune Municipal Corporation.
Ward Office – Dhole Patil Road Kshetriya Karyalaya.
Assembly Constituency – Pune Cantonment Assembly Constituency 214
Parliamentary Constituency – Pune Lok Sabha Constituency.
Pin code – 411001 & 411011
Post Office – B.A Chowk
Major Landmarks – Ladkat Petrol Pump, Sinchan Bhavan, Chhatrapati Shivaji Stadium, Dr.Babasaheb Ambedkar Sanskrutik Bhavan, State excise office at 37.Wellesly Road, Dadasaheb Gaikwad PMC Clinic, Juna Bazar, Railway Bharav, Old Sangam Bridge, Shamrao Kalmadi School (Kannada medium school), Rabindranath Tagore Vidyanikatan, Sassoon Hospital, Pune Railway Station, Maldhakka Chowk, Narpatgiri Chowk, Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan office at Barane Road, Bholaikhana, Bholai Mata Mandir, Datta,Anusuya & Atri Temple, Mahalaxmi Temple on Lane No.1A, Vishweshwar Temple on Lane no.1B, There is an 'Cafe Canada' located on Wellesly Road which reminds of british times. Newly on going Aum Antakrish Towers is giving a new skyline to the neighbourhood.
Major Roads – Wellesly Road (Dr.Ambedkar Road), Pune Railway Station Road (Jawaharlal Nehru Road), Pune Station Road, Barane Road, Sangam Bridge Road, Gadital Road, Veer Santaji Ghorpade Road(VSG Road).
Bridges/Pool on Manik Odha – Sadanand Nagar Pool & Bhimnagar Pool & Barane Road Pool, Connecting to Mangalwar Peth. Ladkat Pool & Shinde Pool & Pandit Pool & Narpatgiri Pool(earlier) now chowk Connecting Somwar Peth, VSG Road Pool Connecting Kasba Peth.
Near by Metro Station – (1) Mangalwar Peth Metro Station(RTO Pune) located on RBM Road Near SSPMS School, (2) Pune Railway Station Metro Station, (3) Kasba Peth Metro Station, (4) Upcoming Collector Office Metro Station & Railway Colony Metro Station.
Near by Railway Station – Pune Railway Station.
Near by Bus Stop – Collector Office, 15 August Chowk, Ambedkar Putala, Sassoon Hospital, Pune Station Moledina, Mangalwar Gadital, Juna Bazar, zilla Parishad, KEM Hospital.
Near by ST Stand – Pune Station ST Stand, Shivaji Nagar Wakdewadi ST Stand, Swargate ST Stand.
Near by Police Station – Narpatgiri Police Chowkey, Gadital (Maldhakka) Police Chowkey, Samarth Police Station, Bund Garden Police Station.
